channel.title: Uplift AV Planning Guides
channel.description: Event AV and livestream planning guides for the Grand Strand.

item.title: Can I use an outside AV company if my hotel has in-house AV?
item.description: Most hotels allow outside AV and production companies, often for a fee. Common fees, what to put in your venue contract and how both teams work together.

item.title: How much does it cost to livestream a conference or convention?
item.description: A professional conference livestream in Myrtle Beach typically costs $3,400 to $9,300 per day. What drives the price, what's included and costs to plan for.
